name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the footplate and your heels free, then secure the pads just above your knees.
Raise your heels enough to take pressure off the catch, then release the safety lever.
Lower your heels until you feel a comfortable stretch through your calves.
Raise your heels smoothly and reengage the catch before removing your legs when finished.
tips: Pause briefly at the bottom stretch on every repetition instead of bouncing the weight upward.
Push evenly across the balls of both feet so your ankles do not roll outward.
